name: lousy-agents
description: Secure, resilient, rugged engineering skills — adversarial testing, structured planning, and production-grade software workflows.

plugins.name: feature-to-plan
plugins.description: Turn feature requests, PRDs, and backlog issues into an EARS-format spec file or one new GitHub issue

plugins.name: go-testable-design
plugins.description: Guide Go development with tests: smallest test first, start from public behavior, keep IO out of decision packages

plugins.name: issue-refine-loop
plugins.description: Rewrite a GitHub issue into session-sized child issues, with dependencies only where work actually blocks

plugins.name: mutation-hunter
plugins.description: Uncover test coverage gaps by applying semantic mutations to production TypeScript, Go, or Python code

plugins.name: plan-to-graph
plugins.description: Convert approved specs, master plans, or GitHub epics into native GitHub Issue dependency graphs with sub-issues and blocking relationships

plugins.name: rugged-evil-tester
plugins.description: Generate adversarial, negative, and chaos tests for TypeScript code — boundary conditions, fuzzing, injection scenarios

plugins.name: skill-reviewer
plugins.description: Rigorously review, validate, and lint Agent Skills SKILL.md files for any agent platform

plugins.name: spec-auditor
plugins.description: Adversarially review feature specifications and implementation plans — expose gaps, contradictions, ambiguity before coding

plugins.name: triaging-pr-reviews
plugins.description: Triage and analyze PR review comments — classify concerns, verify claims against actual code, evaluate trade-offs

plugins.name: curate-release
plugins.description: Rewrite a pull request's commits into a coherent release story that semantic-release can publish, without changing file contents

plugins.name: designing-for-intent
plugins.description: Review a UX flow, agentic handoff point, or delegation-boundary decision for agency risks and articulation barriers before implementation — advocating for the user's intent map, not the screen in front of you

plugins.name: customer-strategy-forge
plugins.description: Turn customer evidence into auditable personas, journeys, progression hypotheses, and product-strategy opportunity maps
